$comment: Education and certification canonical values, plus the id vocabulary that feeds the
'engineering' is trade AND education vocabulary in this product, and is exactly the
_COMPANY_SUFFIX collision that once deleted 'Diploma Mechanical Engineering' from a
worker's profile — the gateway masked it as an employer and nothing rescued it.
_ID_LABELS and _ID_ACRONYMS are deliberately NOT here: _ID_LABELS is DERIVED from the
machines/controllers/welding/skills tables, so extracting it would mint a second source
of truth for the same facts.
